appearance_facts.fact: A single teal line with four circular markers rises from the lower-left to the upper-right, showing a continuous upward slope across the displayed years.
Markers are positioned above the 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020 tick labels.
The 2017 marker is at the 260 gridline level, the 2018 marker is just above 290, the 2019 marker is just above 320, and the 2020 marker is just below 380.
